name: Family History
geometry: Hand-authored editable paths, primitive shapes, and vector masks. No embedded raster images, fonts, scripts or remote assets.
transparency: logo.svg uses real transparent cutouts; mono-white is the reverse version for dark backgrounds.
colors: Exact intended palette tokens replace approximate shaded source pixels. Monochrome exports are separate variants.
notes: FH06 medallion retained as an alternate with mint people and a jade cable.
approval: Production asset study for visual review; unresolved candidate/palette choices are preserved from the prior handoff. Not deployed.
pngSizing: Logo PNGs preserve intrinsic proportions with a 512 px longest edge. App/favicons use separate square canvases.
